question: What is the name of a cycling track?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Velodrome**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Velodrome:
 
• A velodrome is an arena for track cycling.
 
• Modern velodromes feature steeply banked oval tracks, consisting of two 180-degree circular bends connected by two straights.
 
• The straights transition to the circular turn through a moderate easement curve.
 
• The first velodromes were constructed during the late 1870s, the oldest of which is Preston Park Velodrome, Brighton, United Kingdom, built-in 1877 by the British Army.
 
• Indoor velodromes were also common, particularly in the late 19th and early 20th centuries.
